newsitem.title: USA: CIBCR leading U.S. inflation index 105.4 in Sept.
newsitem.headline: CIBCR leading U.S. inflation index 105.4 in Sept.

text.p: The Center for International Business Cycle Research (CIBCR) leading U.S. inflation index rose to 105.4 in September from a revised 104.8 in August, CIBCR said.
Faster growth of industrial materials prices and higher prices reported by purchasing managers contributed to the rise in the index, CIBCR said.
"The new data indicate a slight increase in inflationary pressures may be in the making," it said.
The CIBCR is affiliated with Columbia University.
